run_factor_analysis_varimax: run factor analysis with varimax rotation on standardized iris dataset features
run_pca_decomposition: run pca decomposition on standardized iris dataset to extract principal components
run_unrotated_factor_analysis: run unrotated factor analysis on standardized iris dataset features
plot_correlation_matrix: plot iris feature correlation matrix as a heatmap with seaborn rdblue colormap
plot_factor_components: plot factor analysis components as heatmaps comparing pca unrotated fa and varimax fa
